div.head: II As 8
div.ab: Be landleasum mannum. And we cwædon, gif hwylc landleas man folgode on oþer scire ⁊ his mægas eft sece, þæt he ðe hine on ða gerade feormige, þæt he hine to folcrihte læde, gif he ðær gylt gewyrce, oþþe forebete.

Be landleasum mannum. Ond we cwædon, gif hwylc londleas mon folgode on oþre scire ⁊ eft his mægas gesece, þæt he hine on þa gerad feormige, ðæt he hine to folcryhte læde, gif he þær gylt gewyrce, oþþe forebete.

[Be þam landleasum monnum, þe on oðre scire folgað.] ⁊ we cwædon, gif hw[ylc] landleas mon folgode on oþre scire ⁊ his mægas eft sece, þæt he hine on þa gerad feormige, þæt he hine to folchrihte læde, gif he þær gylt gewyrce, oððe forebete.

De illis qui terram non habent, si seruiant in alio comitatu (et in a. c. famulantur). Item diximus: si quis non habens terram seruiat in alio comitatu et ad cognatos suos quandoque redeat, qui eum in ipso reditu (ipsa uisitatione), firmabit, eum ad rectum (ius) publicum representet, si ibi forisfaciat, uel emendet pro eo.

Be landleasum mannum. Ond we cwædon, gif hwylc londleas mon folgode on oþre scire ⁊ eft his mægas gesece, þæt he hine on þa gerad feormige, ðæt he hine to folcryhte læde, gif he þær gylt gewryce, oþþe forebete.

And we have declared that any landless man who has been serving in another shire, returns to his relatives, he who entertains him shall do so [only] on the condition that if he commits any offence there, he [who entertains him] shall bring him to justice, or pay compensation on his behalf.

Concerning landless men. And we have pronounced, that if any landless man took service in another shire, and afterwards returns to his kinsmen, he [any kinsman] is to harbour him [only] on condition that he brings him to justice if he commits any offence there, or he is to pay the compensation on his behalf.

Von Leuten ohne Grundbesitz (die in anderer Grafschaft dienen. So) Und wir bestimmten: wenn jemand ohne Grundbesitz in eine fremde Grafschaft sich commendirt hat und nachher seine Verwandten wieder aufsucht, dass er [der Wirth] ihn [nur] unter dem Beding beherberge, dass er ihn, falls dieser [Besucher] dort eine Schuld verwirkt, zum öffentlichen Gerichte stelle oder für ihn Busse zahle.

Of men without land (who serve in another shire. So) And we determined: if anyone without land has commended himself into another shire and afterwards visits his kinsmen again, that he [the host] harbour him [only] on the condition that, if this [visitor] incurs a fault there, he bring him to the public court or pay compensation for him.
div.note: H's heading is not from the archetype (Liebermann supplies it from So and Quadr.). Ld's ‘ðe’ in ‘he ðe hine’ is to be struck out.
